components.name: Tour
components.summary: A few callouts, one at a time, each pointing at something
components.description: Tour shows one callout at a time beside an element of the page: a title, a sentence or two, where the tour is, and buttons to go on, go back or skip. Each step names its target by `id`; the callout sits under, over or beside it and flips for room. The app holds which step is in view, so it can start, end and remember the tour. The page is not dimmed and stays usable: the callout points, it does not block.
